terra.problem: The cookie-box label joke has no clear connection to choosing a country. It is not clear why an Assyria label would require starting over.
Calling the names a tongue twister jokes about how Bible names are said. There is also no such list in the verse.
The verse asks whether a young lion growls if he has caught nothing. It does not say an empty den gives a lion nothing to growl about.
The lion roaring at clouds is presented as a funny picture, but there is no clear joke or punchline.
The line about the trap says it springs when it has something to catch, then confusingly says 'or here, nothing to catch.' The verse's question points the other way.
The verse says the horn sounds and the people tremble. It does not identify the horn as an alarm.
The scrolling line puts a modern phone habit directly into the city in the Bible illustration, rather than making an everyday comparison.
The verse does not say why the horn sounds or identify it as a warning.
Identifying Amos as a prophet is a fact from outside this passage and needs a reference.
Saying he will keep his jokes in the drawer comments on how he is telling the passage.
The line about preferring to store cookies makes a light comparison with violence and destruction.
The explanation equates the house of Jacob with the people of Israel without a reference establishing the connection.
The verse says the altar horns will be cut off and fall to the ground. It does not say nothing gets carried off.
